description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, managing fragment navigation via bottom navigation and providing a method to share text content.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting bottom navigation for Home (Browse), Favorites, and Add Recipe screens, with fragment management and sharing functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures bottom navigation item selection handling, and loads the default fragment.

methods.name: openFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the provided fragment in the fragment container.

methods.name: shareText
methods.description: Launches a chooser to share text content with other apps.
